title: Currency!
description: A currency mod that "stays true to how its done in real life!"
body:
**DISCLAIMER : YOU'RE GONA NEED SOMEONE TO /GIVE PERMIT TO PRODUCE COINS!**


This mod allows you to have an controlled currency in your minecraft server!
The currency is produced by players with currency permit whixh consists of gold,iron,copper coins.
You can think of the coins's value as:
- Gold Coin   = 1
- Iron Coin   = 0.5
- Copper Coin = 0.25

You can convert between them by crafting!
